story.text: 남포동 이 골목, 우리 옛날에 맨날 왔던 데다.
story.reading: nam-po-dong i gol-mok, u-ri yen-nal-e maen-nal wat-deon de-da.
story.en: This alley in Nampo-dong, we used to come here all the time back then.

story.text: 이거 봐라, 어릴 때 우리 사진. 이 '추억'이 아직도 여 있더라.
story.reading: i-geo bwa-ra, eo-ril ttae u-ri sa-jin. i chu-eok-i a-jik-do yeo it-deo-ra.
story.en: Look at this, a picture of us as kids. This memory is still right here.

story.reading: i dong-ne o-ni-kka gap-ja-gi geu-rim-ne, geu-ttae-ga.
story.en: Coming to this neighborhood, I suddenly miss those days.

story.text: 근데 사진 속 니랑 지금 니랑 보니까... 좀 '낯설다', 이상하게.
story.reading: geun-de sa-jin sok ni-rang ji-geum ni-rang bo-ni-kka... jom nat-seol-da, i-sang-ha-ge.
story.en: But comparing the you in the photo and the you now... it feels strangely unfamiliar.

story.text: '새삼' 니가 많이 컸구나 싶고... 아니 뭐, 그냥 그렇다고.
story.reading: sae-sam ni-ga man-i keot-gu-na sip-go... a-ni mwo, geu-nyang geu-reo-ta-go.
story.en: I realize all over again how much you've grown up... I mean, whatever, just saying.
Whoa, why am I suddenly getting awkward mid-sentence.

story.text: 자갈치 쪽으로 걸으면서 옛날 얘기나 더 하자.
story.reading: ja-gal-chi jjok-eu-ro geol-eu-myeon-seo yen-nal yae-gi-na deo ha-ja.
story.en: Let's walk toward Jagalchi and talk more about the old days.

story.text: 단어는 다 봤제? 대화 문제도 있으니까 잘 읽어봐라.
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da bwat-je? dae-hwa mun-je-do it-eu-ni-kka jal ilg-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: Got a look at all the words? There's a conversation question too, so read it carefully.

words.example_en: This photo is a precious memory.
There are times I miss my hometown.

words.example: 처음 간 도시는 모든 게 낯설었다.
words.example_reading: cheo-eum gan do-si-neun mo-deun ge nat-seol-eot-da
words.example_en: In the city I visited for the first time, everything felt unfamiliar.
I felt gratitude anew for his consideration.
Meeting after a long time, it was a bit awkward.

sentences.ko: 이 사진을 보니 어릴 적 추억이 떠올랐다.
sentences.reading: i sa-jin-eul bo-ni eo-ril jeok chu-eok-i tteo-ol-lat-da
sentences.en: Looking at this photo, memories from my childhood came to mind.
I sometimes miss my hometown friends.

sentences.ko: 오랜만에 만난 그가 왠지 낯설게 느껴졌다.
sentences.reading: o-raen-man-e man-nan geu-ga waen-ji nat-seol-ge neu-kkyeo-jyeot-da
sentences.en: Somehow, meeting him after so long felt unfamiliar.
I was struck anew by how much he had changed.
It suddenly got quiet and the mood became awkward.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이거 봐라, 니 초등학교 때 사진. 머리 이거 뭐고?
turns.reading: i-geo bwa-ra, ni cho-deung-hak-gyo ttae sa-jin. meo-ri i-geo mwo-go?
turns.en: Look at this, your elementary school picture. What's with this hair?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 아 그거 지우라 캤잖아! 어디서 났노 그건.
turns.reading: a geu-geo ji-u-ra kaet-jan-a! eo-di-seo nan-no geu-geon.
turns.en: I told you to delete that! Where did you even get it.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 내가 몰래 간직하고 있었지. 니 놀릴 일 있을까 봐.
turns.reading: nae-ga mol-lae gan-jik-ha-go it-eot-ji. ni nol-lil il it-eul-kka bwa.
turns.en: I've been secretly keeping it, in case I ever needed to tease you.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Wow, you're really mean, you know that.

dialogues.question: 선우가 사진을 간직해 온 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why has Sunwoo been keeping the photo?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 승객을 놀릴 목적으로 어릴 적 사진을 몰래 간직해 왔다고 말하고 있습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이 골목, 그대로네. 우리 여서 많이 놀았는데.
turns.reading: i gol-mok, geu-dae-ro-ne. u-ri yeo-seo man-i nol-at-neun-de.
turns.en: This alley, it's just the same. We used to play here so much.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Right, we used to meet here every day back then.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: ...니랑 계속 이래 지낼 수 있으면 좋겠다.
turns.reading: ...ni-rang gye-sok i-rae ji-nael su it-eu-myeon jo-ket-da.
turns.en: ...I wish we could keep going on like this together.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Huh? What's this sudden talk about?

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 선우의 태도 변화로 알 수 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What does the shift in Sunwoo's tone in this conversation suggest?
options: 옛 친구가 보고 싶어 슬퍼하는 모습
dialogues.explanation: 평소 장난스럽던 선우가 순간 진지해지며 속마음을 내비쳤다가, 승객의 반응에 당황하는 장면입니다.
